notes: Public-API evoked-ordering witness translated from the deletion branch of the 62-assertion native Attribute Ownership Acquisition If Available integration case. A requester publishes and subscribes to the adapter-named class and attribute, discovers an owner-held object, queues If Available, and leaves its callback queue unserviced. The owner deletes that object before callback servicing. The requester must receive exactly one tagged Remove Object Instance callback and no stale Attribute Ownership Unavailable or Acquisition Notification. This cross-service deletion/nullification assertion has no dedicated granular candidate in the pinned Requirements Lab export; the catalog maps page-152-l101-32 only to the accepted If Available request, not to deletion nullification. The case uses official IEEE 1516.1-2025 C++ headers and standard Java API only; provider, FOM, endpoint, names, HLA_EVOKED, and time implementation come from the adapter. HLA_IMMEDIATE is explicitly skipped. Current-source installed-package C++ primary and contract passed 2/2 evoked; Java compiles against the official API-only JAR but no Java provider-runtime result is claimed.
